meta.name: enrich-with-signals
meta.description: Pull PredictLeads buying-intent signals (jobs, news, funding, tech, leadership changes) for a result set of companies and write them back into the local cache. Use when the user says 'enrich these companies with signals', 'add buying signals to this list', 'pull intent data for [domain]', 'check signals for these accounts', or 'fetch jobs and news for these companies'. Side-effecting — calls PredictLeads API and writes to local SQLite + JSON cache.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为潜在客户名单补充购买意向信号
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在公司列表中快速获取购买意向信号。
copy.tagline_en: Enrich company lists with buying-intent signals
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly add buying-intent signals to a list of companies.

howto.what: 为结果集中的每个公司调用PredictLeads API获取购买意向信号（工作、新闻、融资、技术、领导层变动），将信号计数和摘要写入本地缓存，并展示给用户。
howto.when: 当你说“enrich these companies with signals”、“add buying signals to this list”、“pull intent data for [domain]”等时触发。

say.text: 请为这个公司列表补充购买信号。
say.note: Claude会确认结果集并询问信号类型。

say.text: 检查这些账户的最新信号。
say.note: Claude会拉取每个公司的信号并展示。

say.text: 拉取这些公司的招聘和新闻信号。
say.note: Claude会默认获取招聘和新闻信号。

howto.what_en: For each company in a result set, calls PredictLeads API to fetch buying-intent signals (jobs, news, funding, tech, leadership changes), writes signal counts and summaries into local cache, and surfaces them to the user.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "enrich these companies with signals", "add buying signals to this list", "pull intent data for [domain]", etc.

say_en.text: Please enrich this list of companies with signals.
say_en.note: Claude will ask which result set and signal types.
Claude will pull signals for each account.

say_en.text: Fetch jobs and news for these companies.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch jobs and news signals by default.
